prompts.name: cow
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent PNG animal sticker for Smart Farm Flutter app, readable at 48–96px. Primary request: ONE cute friendly dairy cow, whole body standing, slight three-quarter front pose, centered square composition, equal generous transparent padding around ears horns feet and tail. Style: polished flat hand-drawn sticker illustration, consistent thick rounded dark cocoa #3A261C outline, cream body, dark brown patches, small warm peach muzzle, tiny black dot eyes, modest happy expression, soft pastel fills with minimal shading, subtle cream-white sticker rim. No texture, no shadows outside subject, no grass, no scenery, no text, no badges, no letters, no UI. Actual transparent background. Animal fills about 80 percent square canvas, clean simple silhouette designed as first animal in a matching cow/pig/goat/chicken set. Match the warm friendly sticker direction of the farm concept references without including any screen or card.
